### [`lawn_layouts`](../../../../src/data/lawn_layouts.asm#L6) `$8C6E-$8F2F`

*data*

Layouts of the 16 lawns, read by $8ba8. Each lawn ends with $ff. This first $ff is the mark before lawn 1.
